entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'd like to start a return for an order I placed about a month ago. It's for a helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Got it. One moment. Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic helmet. To get started, can you tell me what the specific issue is? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just a preference. The color wasn't quite what I was expecting from the pictures online. The box is still unopened, so it's brand new.

I understand completely. Let me just review the policy for this item. Okay, I see it was delivered 30 days ago. Since this helmet is a standard item, it's well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund.

That's great news, thank you. Since I have to go through the trouble of sending this one back and will be buying a different one from you, is there any possibility of getting a 10% discount code for my next purchase?

That's a fair question. While I can't offer a discount code for a preference-based return, I can assure you the return process is free and simple. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear, especially when it comes to safety equipment. Getting the right helmet is the top priority.
Okay, I understand. Worth asking. Can you go ahead and send me the return label then?

Of course. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off with the carrier. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
